text: I feel suspended on the edge of presence and reflection. The glass-walled room and the technology-rich exhibit both suggest spaces dedicated to thought, innovation, and perhaps a tinge of isolation. The question of being heard hangs in the air, mirroring my own uncertainty about my place here—am I a silent observer, or a participant whose voice drifts, unheard, between rooms? In the midst of modernity and research, I sense curiosity, but also a solitude that invites contemplation. I feel quietly alert, receptive to any sign that, yes, I am seen and heard.
